selection_scope: BF16 common-stack V1/V2/V3 only; final selection pending profiling and secondary CA
gain_estimator: 1 - exp(mean(log(TPOT_LA/TPOT_BR))); paired 95% t intervals; every valid sample retained
selection_rule: Existing frozen evaluator: maximize minimum paired LA gain across B128/B256 among stable, non-dominated arms. Reject arms with no-better absolute LA TPOT in either batch and >2% worse in at least one than another stable arm. No tuning after observing LA.
scope: Optimal only among these three planned arms, at frozen BR-tuned P/trigger. Profiling and secondary CA/default adoption remain separate. Stable two-pair outcomes are not repeated for significance.
